definitions.aov: GMV divided by the number of orders
definitions.gmv: sum of item prices in BRL, excluding freight
definitions.is_late: delivery_days > promised_days, both counted in calendar days from the purchase date
definitions.payment_total: final charged amount; differs from price + freight by vouchers and interest

rules.description: keep orders with status 'delivered' (lateness is only defined for delivered orders)
drop 'delivered' orders that have no customer delivery date
keep purchases from 2017-01-01 to 2018-08-31 (2016 and Sep/Oct 2018 are sparse edges)
drop orders delivered before purchase; null carrier timestamps that are out of sequence (post-purchase fields, never used as features)
aggregate items to one row per order (counts, price, freight, weight, volume, primary item); drop orders without items
drop payment rows typed 'not_defined' or with value <= 0, aggregate per order (type of the largest payment); drop orders left without a valid payment
keep the latest review per order (score only; free text is never loaded into clean data)
join customer and primary-seller geography; distance between zip-prefix centroids (null when a prefix is unknown); city names dropped
derive purchase time parts, promised_days and delivery_days (calendar days) and is_late = delivery_days > promised_days
fixed column order and dtypes, stable sort by (purchase_ts, order_id)
